text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, July 15 - Bombay - Delays expected for vessels due, containers 1-2 days, bulk vessels 8-10 days, general cargo 3-4 days. 7 Vessels loading at berth, 22 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage. 12 Waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 under repair, 1 awaiting orders. Floating crane situation remains unchanged. Calcutta - 22 Vessels due (2 coking coal, 8 product tankers, 7 containers, 1 crude, 3 tneb coal, 1 steel crack). 8 Vessels loading at berth, 22 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 12 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 bunkering. Cochin - 13 Vessels due, up to 1 days delay expected. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 1 general cargo at CSL jetty, 1 tanker at repair dock.

Chennai (Madras) - 29 Vessels due - 7 coal, 4 general cargo, 2 fertiliser, 2 iron ore, 2 baryte, 8 containers, 1 palm oil, 1 fertiliser, 1 granite blocks, 1 stone. Delays, coal/coke, iron ore and others 2-3 days, fertiliser, scrap 5-6 days. 5 Vessels loading at berth, 10 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Mormugao - Vessels due, 2 ores, 1 alumina, 1 container vessel. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load.

Kandla - Nine vessels due, 15-16 days delay expected. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 11 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 loading in stream, 4 discharging at berth, 3 discharging at stream, 3 tankers. 17 Vessels waiting, 7 waiting to discharge. Mangalore - 13 Vessels due, 2-3 days delay expected. 6 Vessels loading/discharging at berth, 2 awaiting berth, 1 under repair. Jawaharlal Nehru - Berthing delays expected, urea 180 days, other fertiliser 35-40 days, 6 tankers/iron ore vessels due, 3-4 days berthing delay expected. 3 Vessels discharging at berth, 5 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Paradip eight vessels due, 10 days delay expected. 5 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge.

Tuticorin - The stevedore association labourers strike was called off at 06.00 hrs. on 13/7. Four vessels due, 2-3 days delay. 7 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 3 discharging at anchorage, 5 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Visakhapatnam - 25 Vessels due, 7-8 days delay expected. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth. 13 Waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth, 6 waiting at anchorage to load at inner harbour berth.

MALAYSIA, July 16 - Port Keelang - North/south port - Container/ro-ro berth - 8 Vessels alongside, 8 waiting. No waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 3 Vessels alongside, 2 berthed, 4 waiting. 3 Days waiting time. Dry/bulk cement terminal - 2 Vessels alongside, 4 waiting, 6 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 2 Vessels alongside, 3 waiting. 1 Day waiting time. West port - Container/ro-ro berth - 2 Vessels alongside, 4 waiting. 1 Day waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 6 Vessels alongside, 3 waiting. 1 Days waiting time. Dry/bulk cement terminal - 1 Vessel alongside, 1 waiting. 2 Days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 2 Vessels alongside, 1 vessel waiting. No waiting time.

MAURITIUS, July 15 - Port Louis - Eight vessels alongside of which 4 discharging and loading containers, 4 general cargo, no idle vessels. Fishing port - 10 Vessels alongside for discharging/bunkering, 1 vessel at outer anchorage awaiting berth. Bunching of vessels expected from 16/7 to 18/7. 1 Day berthing delay expected.

PAKISTAN, July 14 - Karachi - Five vessels due, up to 1 days delay for general cargo/container vessels, 2 days delay for tankers. 4 Vessels loading at berth (rice and containers), 5 containerers loading and discharging at berth, 5 discharging at berth (gasoil, fuel oil, general cargo, tallow). 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load molasses, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge gas oil, sugar, 2 awaiting orders. Port Qasim - Four vessels discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge sugar.

SINGAPORE, July 15 - Singapore - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 14 Container vessels berthed, minimum berthing delays. Keppel terminal - 2 Container/general cargo vessels berthed, minimum berthing delays. Pasir Panjang terminal - 14 Container/general cargo vessels berthed, minimum berthing delays. Sembawang terminal - 3 General cargo vessels berthed, minimum berthing delays. Jurong port - 1 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessel berthed, minimum berthing delays. Oil terminal/SBM buoys - 19 Tankers berthed, minimum berthing delays.

SOUTH KOREA, July 15 - Inchon - 69 Vessels in port (45 berthed, 24 anchored) of which 8 logs, 6 each general cargo, corn, 3 pig iron, 2 each salt, raw sugar, cotton seed meal, coils, containers, cars, scrap, 1 each steel, h-beam, molasses, soybean meal, wheat blending pellets, maize, soda ash, plywood. Anchored - 4 each coils, containers, 3 wheat, 2 each logs, corn, copra, 1 each tapioca, pipes, soybean, steel, soda, palm oil, pig iron. Approx. 1-2 days day expected. Busan - 150 Vessels (41 berthed, 109 anchored including 55 laid up) of which 27 general cargo, 9 containers, 3 scrap, 2 coal. 54 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 1 day delay expected.

Pohang - 29 Vessels (26 berthed, 3 anchored) of which discharging, 7 steel scrap, 6 steel products, 3 each clinker, iron ore. 7 Vessels loading steel products, 3 awaiting berth with approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Ulsan - 28 Vessels (25 berthed, 3 anchored) of which discharging, 2 each feed meal, zinc concentrates, corn, 1 each coal, logs, mono ethyl glycol, paraxylene, woodchips, styrene monomer, copper concentrates, caustic soda. Loading, 3 general cargo, 3 fertiliser, 2 chemicals, 1 each sulphuric acid, fuel oil, diesel oil. 3 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 3 days delay expected. Masan - Four vessels berthed of which discharging, 1 scrap, 1 steel plates, 1 logs, 1 mangan, no berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, July 15 - Colombo - Vessels due, 11 containers/feeders, 1 bagged cement, 1 bagged sugar. Delays, general cargo 2-3 days, container (feeders) 24 hours. Vessels loading at berth, 2 essential services, 11 containers, 1 general cargo. Discharging at berth, 1 steel billets, 11 containers, 1 bagged flour, 2 bagged cement, 1 bagged mop, 1 bulk cement, 2 general cargo, 2 ro-ro, 3 bagged fertiliser. Waiting at anchorage to discharge, 5 containers, 1 lpg, 1 bagged sugar, 1 bagged flour, 1 bagged urea. 3 Vessels bunkering, 1 under repair, 8 court arrest orders, 5 awaiting orders from principals, 1 crew change, 1 vessel at spbm. Galle - One vessel loading at berth. Trincomalee - One vessel discharging at berth, 2 loading at berth.

TAIWAN, July 15 - Keelung - Vessels in port, 11 containers, 1 tanker, 6 other bulkers, 4 general. 1 Container vessel waiting at outer anchorage, 6 hours berthing delay. Kaohsiung - July 16 - Three days delay in port. 13 Vessels loading at berth, 54 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 6 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 8 Vessels bunkering, 3 under repair/drydock, 1 awaiting orders.
THAILAND, July 10 - Bangkok - 68 Vessels in port of which 6 containers, 1 tanker, 61 other bulkers and general cargo vessels. 4 Vessels waiting at outer anchorage, no berthing delays expected.
